# <span id="aanchor36"></span> Tank Editor - Flow Data

[&lt;&lt; Back](../Tank%20Editor.md) \| [Gauging](Tank%20Editor_Flow%20-%20Gauging.md) \| <a href="#" class="selected">Tickets</a> \| [Daily](Tank%20Editor_Flow%20-%20Daily.md) \| [Monthly](Tank%20Editor_Flow%20-%20Monthly.md)

#### Tickets Tab

The Tickets tab displays movement associated with run tickets. Double-click record to open the associated ticket for viewing or editing.

Run tickets can be created and deleted directly from the Tickets tab.

<div class="procedure">

To enter a run ticket:

1.  Open the Ticket Detail form for a run ticket. Three options are available:
    - Navigate to the Tank Editor and select a tank. Click the **Tickets** tab, right-click the grid, and select **New Tank Level**.
    - Navigate to the Ticket Editor and select **Tank Gauge**. Right-click the grid, and select **New Ticket**.
    - Navigate to the Ticket Search. Right-click the grid, and select **New Ticket** \> **Tank Run**.

2.  Edit the date as needed. The ticket will follow tank characteristics for the time span that contains the effective date of the ticket. This will determine the status, component calculation, and data entry mode. (See: [Tank Characteristics](../Configuration/Tank%20Editor_Config%20-%20Characteristics%20Tab.md))

3.  Define the inventory movement time frame using the **Movement Start Date** and **Movement End Date** fields.

4.  Select a product from the list. If the tank has been set up with a list of valid products, only those will appear in the drop-down. If a default product was specified, it will be pre-selected.

5.  Click the browse buttons next to the **Direction** and **Class** fields to select these values.

6.  Enter appropriate tank run information. Data points will differ for each tank type. The data to be entered and the calculation methods will vary based on the data entry mode for the tank.

    <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Open and Close Values for Level Only">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Open and Close Values for Level Only</a>

    <div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Open and Close Values for Level Only">

    The Open Level and Close Level values specify the depth of the fluid within the tank at the start and end of the movement, respectively. Both need to be provided for the movement volume and mass to be calculated.

    Values required for each calculation step are identical to those required for the tank gauge ticket for each respective tank type. For details, see Entering Gauge Tickets.

    <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Open and Close Values for all Levels">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Open and Close Values for All Levels</a>

    <div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Open and Close Values for all Levels">

    The Open and Close set of values specify conditions and quantities of the fluid in the tank at the start and end of the movement, respectively. Open level and open parameters need to be provided for the open volume and mass to be calculated. Close level and close parameters need to be provided for the close volume and mass to be calculated. Delta volume and mass are calculated when both corresponding open and close values are available.

    - **Required values for calculation** - Values required for each calculation step in the open set and close set are identical to those required for the tank gauge ticket for each respective tank type. For details, see Entering Gauge Tickets.
    - **Extended detail form** - Given the large number of data points that are involved in the complete calculation of open, close and delta set of quantities, the run ticket form only displays the minimal set of required values for calculation. The extended detail form can be used to view, edit, and calculate the complete set of values for the given tank type.

    <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Upright Cylindrical Tank Run Tickets Ext">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Upright Cylindrical Tank Run Tickets</a>

    <div class="drop-down" style="background-color: #ffffff; display: none;" mc-target-name="Upright Cylindrical Tank Run Tickets Ext">

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 524;height: 427;" />

    Click the **Extended Detail** button at the bottom to open the extended detail form.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 522;height: 473;" />

    If the ticket detail is in view mode, the extended detail will open in view mode where data can only be viewed.

    If the ticket detail is in edit mode, the extended detail will open in edit mode. The user will be able to edit data and use calculate button to trigger calculation and check results in detail. Edits made in the ticket detail or in the extended detail are synched to the other form.

    </div>

    <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Horizontal Tank Run Ticket Ext">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Horizontal Tank Run Tickets</a>

    <div class="drop-down" style="background-color: #ffffff; display: none;" mc-target-name="Horizontal Tank Run Ticket Ext">

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 523;height: 427;" />

    Click the **Extended Detail** button at the bottom to open the extended detail form.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 522;height: 439;" />

    If the ticket detail is in view mode, the extended detail will open in view mode where data can only be viewed.

    If the ticket detail is in edit mode, the extended detail will open in edit mode. The user will be able to edit data and use calculate button to trigger calculation and check results in detail. Edits made in the ticket detail or in the extended detail are synched to the other form.

    </div>

    <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Spherical Tank Run Ticket">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Spherical Tank Run Tickets</a>

    <div class="drop-down" style="background-color: #ffffff; display: none;" mc-target-name="Spherical Tank Run Ticket">

    For spherical tank run tickets, observed and measurement conditions for both the start and end of the movement are also to be entered in separate open and close fields. The open conditions are needed to calculate the volume at the open of the movement, and the close conditions are needed to calculate the volume at the end of the movement.

    All fields on the run ticket detail need to be populated to calculate the Total NSV and Total Mass of the movement. If FLOWCAL does not have data needed to calculate either the open or the close volume amount, FLOWCAL will not be able to calculate the NSV and mass of the movement displayed in the run ticket detail.

    Not all data points are displayed and editable. More data points for a spherical tank run ticket can be viewed in the Ticket Editor or the Ticket Search grids.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 527;height: 429;" />

    </div>

    </div>

7.  Click **Calculate** to see the results.

8.  Enter data on the **Accounting**, **Analysis**, **Components**, and **Custom Fields** tabs as needed.

9.  Click the browse button to select a value for the **Direction** field.

10. Click the browse button to select a value for the **Class** field.

11. Select an edit reason.

12. Click **Save**.

13. When the data is complete, click **Exit**.

</div>
